author: The Associated Press
title: Golf News and Upcoming Tournaments
text:
• The AIG Women's British Open is being held at Royal Lytham & St. Annes in England.
• The course yardage is 6,585 and the par is 72.
• The prize money is $10 million and the winner's share is $1.5 million.
• The defending champion is Miyu Yamashita.
• The Race to CME Globe leader is Nelly Korda.
• Jenny Shin won the Women's Scottish Open last week.
• The Women's British Open is the final major of the LPGA season.
• Nelly Korda or Haeran Ryu can become the first to capture three majors in a season since Inbee Park in 2013.
• This is the sixth time the Women's British Open is being held at Royal Lytham & St. Annes.
• The last time it was held there was in 2018 and won by Georgia Hall of England.
• Catriona Matthew won at Royal Lytham & St. Annes in 2009 just 11 weeks after giving birth to her daughter.
• Lytham St. Annes is about 30 miles from Southport, where the British Open was held two weeks ago.
• Korda is coming off a missed cut at the Evian Championship and a tie for 16th in the Women's Scottish Open.
• Lilia Vu is the only American to win the Women's British Open in the last 12 years.
• The Women's British Open has been an LPGA major since 2001.
• Karrie Webb won a year later to become the only woman to win five different majors.
• The next tournament is the Standard Portland Classic on Aug. 13-16.
• The Rocket Classic is being held at Detroit.
• The course yardage is 7,328 and the par is 70.
• The prize money is $10 million and the winner's share is $1.8 million.
• The defending champion is Aldrich Potgieter.
• The FedEx Cup leader is Scottie Scheffler.
• Jackson Koivun won the 3M Open last week.
• This is the eighth and final year of the Rocket Classic in Detroit.
• The field includes seven of the top 25 in the world ranking.
• Cameron Young, the No. 3 player in the world, is playing in the tournament.
• The field includes U.S. Open champion Wyndham Clark.
• Cameron Davis of Australia has two PGA Tour victories, both of them at the Rocket Classic.
• Only two tournaments remain before the top 70 are determined for the FedEx Cup postseason.
• Keegan Bradley and Brooks Koepka are in the field this week.
• The next tournament is the Wyndham Championship.
• The Portugal Invitational is being held at Vilamoura, Portugal.
• The course yardage is 7,335 and the par is 72.
• The prize money is $3 million and the winner's share is $450,000.
• The defending champion is a new tournament.
• The Charles Schwab Cup leader is Stewart Cink.
• Jerry Kelly won the Senior British Open last week.
• This is a new tournament on the PGA Tour Champions.
• The only other two tournaments held outside the United States are in Morocco and Canada.
• Jerry Kelly's victory earns him a spot at St. Andrews for the 155th British Open next year.
• Stewart Cink leads the PGA Tour Champions with four victories this year.
• Ernie Els redesigned the golf course.
• Padraig Harrington is playing his eighth consecutive week.
• The next tournament is the Boeing Classic on Aug. 14-16.
• The Utah Championship is being held at Ogden, Utah.
• The course yardage is 7,097 and the par is 70.
• The prize money is $1 million and the winner's share is $180,000.
• The defending champion is Julian Suri.
• The points leader is Doc Redman.
• Tommy Morrison won the Evans Scholars Invitational last week.
• The next tournament is the Pinnacle Bank Championship.
• The Danish Golf Championship is being held on Aug. 13-16.
• The defending champion is Ryan Fox.
• The Race to Dubai leader is Patrick Reed.
• The LIV Golf League is being held at Indianapolis on Aug. 20-23.
• The points leader is Jon Rahm.
• The Infortar Estonia Challenge is being held at the Estonian Golf & CC in Estonia.
• The defending champion is a new tournament.
• The Aurora World Championship is being held at the Aurora Golf and Resort in Wonju, South Korea.
• The defending champion is Sohyun Bae.
summary: ... Catriona Matthew won at Royal Lytham & St. Annes in 2009 just 11 weeks after giving birth to her daughter. Blades Brown would have been in the field from the alternate list but withdrew to play on the Korn Ferry Tour, where he is 12th in the standings.
